summary: quick-dev-tdd-adapter applies only to an explicit execution-plan directory/file with valid implementation-contract.v1.json; parent route caller must be quick-dev-tdd-adapter and yield strict_tdd_plan plus matching backend; paths must remain under execution-plans and target discovery is directory-local; report/run-state are non-authoritative; audit, repair, validate, and refreeze identities before RED; run loop_plan_directory before expensive actions; run-slice uses generated run_context and lifecycle tooling; require observed failing RED before production writes, then GREEN, REFACTOR, and plan-local predicate; continue slices until implementation-complete, external-repair-required, or repeated failure; acceptance/release/commit authority remains external; skill-input contract receipt, typed consumer request, and require-ready validation are mandatory; classify route as architectural, complex, normal, or small_mechanical from closed facts, with unknowns blocked as complex; knowledge context and freeze receipts must verify before RED; persistent loop requires explicit non-wildcard snapshot paths and exact planned_new_files handling; preserve failed evidence as stale-linked successors; shell-free structured commands and drift rejection required; read backend, TDD protocol, and evidence/freshness references before implementation; version gate uses Context7 only for changed external versions, otherwise not applicable.
